subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Security Is Everyone's Job
description: A fast breakdown of Security Is Everyone's Job for builders.

hook.text: A developer says 'security is the security team's problem.' Then their code causes the breach.

buildup.text: Traditional security teams audit at the end. By then, insecure patterns are baked deep into the code.

discovery.text: Secure development means every developer writes code with security in mind from the first line.

twist.text: Security teams shift from gatekeepers to coaches, teaching secure patterns instead of just finding flaws.

climax.text: Teams where developers own security have 50% fewer vulnerabilities than those with siloed security groups.

punchline.text: Security isn't a department. It's a shared responsibility.

quiz.question: What is the most effective security approach?
options: A dedicated security audit at launch
Every developer writing secure code from the start
